author: tom
title: How BetStop works, and how to register
dek: BetStop excludes you from every licensed online and phone wagering provider in Australia at once.
body:
BetStop is the National Self-Exclusion Register. Registering blocks you from opening or using accounts with every licensed online and phone wagering provider in Australia, in one step. It is free, it is run by the Australian Communications and Media Authority, and it does not affect your credit rating.

What BetStop does

Before BetStop, self-exclusion meant contacting each bookmaker separately. Now a single registration applies to all of them. Once you are registered, licensed providers must:

  • close any existing accounts you hold and refund your balance;
  • refuse to open a new account for you;
  • stop sending you marketing, including emails, texts and app notifications.

BetStop covers online and phone betting with licensed providers. It does not cover pubs, clubs, casinos or retail TAB outlets; those venues have separate state-based exclusion programs.

How long it lasts

You choose the period, from a minimum of three months up to a lifetime exclusion. During the period you cannot cancel early. That is deliberate: the register is meant to hold when the urge to bet returns.

OptionCan you end it early?
3 months to 12 monthsNo
1 to 5 yearsNo
LifetimeAfter at least 12 months, with a cooling-off process

You can extend an exclusion at any time if you feel you need longer.

How to register

  1. Go to betstop.gov.au and choose to register.
  2. Verify your identity online, with a driver licence, passport or Medicare card.
  3. Pick your exclusion period.
  4. Confirm. The exclusion applies to providers within one business day, often sooner.

The process usually takes under ten minutes. You can also nominate a support person, who will be told that you have registered and can help you through the period.

What happens to your money

Providers must close your accounts and return any remaining balance to your nominated bank account. Pending bets are settled or voided according to each provider's terms. You do not lose money you have already deposited.

Other support

Self-exclusion works best alongside support. Gambling Help Online offers free, confidential counselling around the clock on 1800 858 858 and through online chat. Many people also find it helpful to block gambling sites on their devices and to tell someone they trust.

The takeaway

If you are worried about your betting, BetStop is the strongest single step available. It takes ten minutes, covers every licensed online bookmaker at once and cannot be undone on a bad day. If you are not ready for that, start with a deposit limit or a short break in your account.
